label: 30d window ending 2026-04-10 12:00 UTC

quality.coverage_rule: valid pixel-frame samples / candidate pixel-frame samples
notes: Catchments below 70% coverage are flagged and should not be silently averaged.
Rainfall is uncalibrated Lizard precipitation archive output.
Duration max_total_mm is the rolling N-frame maximum within the parent window. Not an AEP, not a design rainfall, no IFD or ARF comparison performed.

Spatial metrics describe rainfall structure inside the critical sub-window. Coefficient of variation, uniformity index, and wet-core ratio are Stormgrid-derived indicators, not engineering design quantities.

methodology_note: Bands describe rainfall volume only. They are NOT an AEP classification, NOT a return-period assignment, and NOT a formal exceedance assertion. Use them for qualitative operational context only.
